items.title: The Hidden Face
items.description: A Spanish orchestra conductor investigates the mysterious disappearance of his girlfriend, uncovering a hidden secret inside their house.

items.title: Tears of Steel
items.description: In an apocalyptic Amsterdam future, a group of warriors and scientists gather to stage a crucial event from the past.

items.title: Sintel

items.title: Elephants Dream
items.description: Two travelers explore a bizarre and surreal mechanical world built from memories and giant gears.
